newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen,JGBs stuck in range on lack of leads.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen,JGBs stuck in range on lack of leads.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures made a listless start to the week on Monday as a lack of fresh incentives and a U.S. holiday severely hampered participation, dealers said.
"There's no impetus for trading Euroyen at the moment. Fundamentally, I'm still bullish but the market is fairly long and the dollar/yen isn't helping," said a trader with a U.S. futures house.
He said the dollar was likely to undergo a retracement if it failed to reach its target of 125.00 yen in the near term and that would provide some support to Euroyen and JGB futures.

Euroyen futures traded a one-tick band all day with September quoted unchanged against its IMM close of 99.37 at 1110 GMT. December was at 99.24 against 99.25. Turnover for both months was 2,380 lots.
March JGBs settled at 126.14 against their previous 126.20.
"A lot of people are just positioning their books for the rollover. If they close above 126.22/24, they could head for 126.50," said the trader.
Eurodollar futures had an even more lethargic day as U.S. interest was curtailed by the President's Day holiday.
Dealers said the market remained well underpinned following Friday's gains in Chicago where an unexpectedly tame January wholesale inflation report boosted the market.
September Eurodollars ended flat against their IMM close at 94.31 on turnover of 1,105 lots.
